name: Spokane County, WA parcels
source_notes: The public Parcels FeatureServer is intentionally thin: parcel, site address/city, acreage, and geometry fields.
Richer assessor data is published as separate ArcGIS Hub item downloads under owner GISspokane. Join those files back to parcel records on the parcel field.

enrichment_sources.name: property_info
enrichment_sources.format: zip containing pipe-delimited property_info.txt and property_info.xlsx

enrichment_sources.name: value_info
enrichment_sources.format: zip containing pipe-delimited value_info.txt and value_info.xlsx
enrichment_sources.row_selection: Use the latest tax_year per parcel for current normalized value fields.

enrichment_sources.name: taxpayer_info
enrichment_sources.usage_note: Spokane County's ArcGIS Hub disclaimer cites RCW 42.56.070(8). That public-records provision governs agency disclosure of lists of individuals requested for commercial purposes; this source definition simply supports joining taxpayer/owner data to public parcel records while preserving source metadata.

enrichment_sources.name: residential_parcel_floor_information
enrichment_sources.format: zip containing pipe-delimited Residential_Parcel_Floor_Information text and spreadsheet files
enrichment_sources.aggregation: Aggregate by parcel for total square feet, finished area, bedrooms, and bathrooms.
